about: Routing eval for the PeopleCoral skills. expected = auto-loaded skill, or null for none. peoplecoral-release is manual (disable-model-invocation): for its queries the model loads nothing and should point the user to /peoplecoral-release (expected 'manual:peoplecoral-release'); loading a generic asc-* skill instead is wrong. Device smoke and doctor load verify-peoplecoral. Production verify-before-submit stays manual:peoplecoral-release. Competing installed skills include asc-release-flow, asc-testflight-orchestration, asc-whats-new-writer, asc-shots-pipeline, asc-screenshot-resize, asc-submission-health.
